results.title: Delimitation Bill: MK Stalin warns Centre, says 'Tamil Nadu will not compromise'
results.description: Reiterating the party's position, the Stalin said there was no change in its stand and ruled out any compromise on the demands."The DMK stands firm on these two demands and will continue to do so. There is no change in our position, and there is no question of any compromise!" he said.
